svg.text: Words in the right column. Kubelet = the agent on each node that starts pods. Device plugin = a program on a node that tells the kubelet which devices

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: it has. DRA (Dynamic Resource Allocation) = a way to ask for devices by their properties. NUMA node = a group of CPU cores with the memory closest to

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: them. PCIe root = the top of one PCIe tree, where the CPU and memory meet the devices. Topology Manager = the kubelet part that keeps a pod's CPUs and

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: devices on one NUMA node. EFA = AWS's NIC for AI work. RDMA = Remote Direct Memory Access, which moves data straight into another machine's memory.

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Units: TB/s and GB/s are bytes per second. Gbps is bits per second (8 bits = 1 byte). (d) = derived: arithmetic on sourced numbers.

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Sources: NVIDIA H100 page (rungs 1 to 3), AWS instance table (rung 4), AWS placement, EFA and pricing pages (rungs 5 and 6), Kubernetes and AWS EKS
